1939年公共租界华人人口
备忘录（存档于人口普查卷宗）

警务处处长伯恩少校（Major Bourne）询问我们是否有关于目前公共租界华人人口的数字。

我告知他没有，但告诉他，据我所知，法租界方面最近进行了一次人口普查，我们可以将适用于法租界的增长系数应用于虹口西部和苏州河以南地区，并采用日本方面关于虹口及东区的普查数据，从而对我们辖区目前的状况有一个大致的了解。

随后经查询发现，法方的人口普查工作并未成功，因此他们对住房状况进行了调查，并得出结论认为，对华人人口的合理估算应为1935年数据的两倍。

因此，如果我们将苏州河以南及虹口西部的1935年数据翻倍，并采用日本方面关于虹口及东区的数据，我们应该能得到在现有情况下最接近的近似值。

我将此信息提供给了伯恩少校，并建议他按上述方式行事，以获取他所需的信息。

R. [签名]

副税务司 - 税收。

税务处，
上海，1939年6月24日。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY. JUL 18 1938

Shanghai Population
Rapidly Increasing

Reports to the effect that there are only 1,170,000 people living in the International Settlement of Shanghai are incorrect. It is reported that there are 2,500,000 people residing in the Settlement at the present time, which is twice the total population of the area before the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities.

The population of the Shanghai French Concession has increased to 1,250,000, according to statistics released by the French Municipal Police. Of the total 1,200,000 are Chinese and 30,000 are foreigners. The total number of police force is 3000 in the concession.

In 1864 only a few score of people lived in the French Concession.

According to a Chinese report the number of Japanese residents in Shanghai has increased to 23,000 and according to the present rate of increase, the total number of Japanese residents in Shanghai will exceed 40,000 before the end of this year.

In 1870 only seven Japanese nationals lived in Shanghai. In 1885 it increased to 595 persons and after the Sino-Japanese war in 1894 the total number of Japanese residents in Shanghai was 736. After the Russo-Japanese War in 1904, 2157 Japanese lived in Shanghai.

Before the outbreak of the World War in 1914 only 9200 Japanese lived in this port city but after the war in 1918 over 15,000 Japanese established their homes in this city. After the Shanghai undeclared war in 1932 there were 28,000 Japanese in Shanghai and now it increased to 32,000.

Most of these Japanese are engaged in retail business such as the selling of piece goods, matches, soap, sugar, and miscellaneous goods. It is reported that more Japanese are coming here to engage in transportation work as well as chemical industries.

在今日的报纸上，我注意到贵报将上海的俄国人口称为25,000人。这是许多为俄文报刊杂志招揽广告的人所引用的数字，并被普遍接受；但这一数字夸大到了荒谬的程度。法租界和公共租界当局定期编制人口普查数据，根据这两个市政当局的最新报告，这两个区域的俄国人口总数为14,845人。从未有人质疑过涉及其他国籍的人口普查数据的准确性，也没有理由相信关于俄国人口的数据不准确。可能有少数俄国人居住在华界区域，但人数不可能很多，俄国人口总数不可能大大超过15,000人。
看来，25,000这个数字代表的是自近二十年前开始登记以来在此注册的俄国人总数。每一位来到中国的俄国人以及所有在沪出生的俄国人都进行了登记。但是，并没有机制将死亡或离境者从名单中剔除。
此致
敬礼
ACCURACY（署名）

INTERNATIONAL RED DAY

Since 1929, August 1 has been known as International Red Day, a date for the toiling masses throughout the world to hold processions and demonstrations, to shout anti-imperialist and anti-war slogans in support of the movement for peace.

China will be the principal sufferer in the second Great War. Therefore, Chinese youths should unite and oppose a second world war and struggle determinedly for their freedom.

JAPANESE CONSULS-GENERAL TO HOLD MEETING AT TIENTSIN.

A telegram from Tientsin dated October 16 states that the Tokyo Foreign Office has decided to call a general meeting of all Japanese Consuls-General in China at Tientsin on October 25 to make arrangements for dealing with the North China affair. ANTI-JAPANESE ACTIVITIES IN FUKIEN.

A Dentsu telegram from Tokyo reports that on October 16 Mr. Yamada, Japanese Consul at Amoy, informed the Foreign Office to the effect that he had requested the Fukien Provincial authorities to suppress the anti-Japanese activities of the Chinese National Salvation Society which had distributed a quantity of anti-Japanese handbills in Fukien with a view to obstructing Chinese going to Formosa to attend an exhibition which is now being opened to celebrate the 40th anniversary of Japanese administration in that island.

MAINICHI

ANTI-JAPANESE TELEGRAM ISSUED BY PROFESSORS OF CHINESE GOVERNMENT UNIVERSITY..

Sir F. Leith-Ross, British economic expert, has visited Japan first before coming to China. This would suggest that China is like a protectorate of Japan. China will come to ruin unless the Nanking Government changes its policy towards Japan.

Min Pao (official organ of the Kuomintang) :

LEE YU SENG'S STATEMENT ON HIS VISIT TO INDIA

In the winter of 1933, Lee Yu Seng(李友生), a teacher of the Lih Deh Institute (立達学園) in Shanghai, proceeded to the International University in India to give lectures at the request of the faculty of that university. He remained there for one year and returned here a short time ago since when he has made the following statement regarding the conditions in India :-

India has a population of 350,000,000 and is the home of Buddhism. Buddhism was spread to China after the East Han Dynasty. At present there are neither monks nor nuns in India and even in the native place of Buddha, no Buddhist activities can be found. It is sometimes stated that the ruin of India may have connection with the fall of Buddhism. In reality this is not right. The ruin of India is due to internal complications and to the divergence of the ideas of the people.

The castes of the Indian people are most complicated. For instance cloth washers have castes among themselves and barbers have their own castes, in all amounting to several thousand castes in the whole country.

The commercial enterprises in India are wholly in the hands of British who also have important influences in politics and economics. There are over 120 small states in India and each state has its own chieftain. The British people have been setting these chieftains one against the other to prevent the country from becoming united. India was not actually ruined by Britain but was given to that country by the Indians themselves who crave individual power.

In 1920, Gandhi, the leader of the Indian revolution, suddenly introduced the policy of passive resistance which has been carried out for more than ten years. Now the British are treating the Indians brutally. Officers-in-Charge of all official organs in India are British and by this means the activities of Indian revolutionaries are being watched by the British, whilst Gandhi's power has been curtailed. Gandhi has resigned from the post of Chairman of the All Indian Congress and has purposely organized a social movement in order to abolish the caste system. Although the present circumstances of China are very bad, her people are still at liberty to do anything they wish. The fact of the ruin of India can be used as an urge for China to strengthen and to save herself, while on the other hand China should make internal reforms in order to save the nation from decadency.

李友生关于其访问印度的声明

1933年冬，上海立达学园教师李友生(李友生)应印度国际大学教职员之邀，前往该大学讲学。他在那里停留了一年，不久前返回此地，此后就印度情况发表了如下声明：

印度人口为3.5亿，是佛教的发源地。佛教在东汉之后传入中国。目前印度既无僧人也无尼姑，甚至在佛陀的故乡也找不到任何佛教活动。有时有人称印度的衰败可能与佛教的衰落有关。实际上这并不正确。印度的衰败是由于内部纠纷和民众思想的分歧所致。

印度人的种姓制度极为复杂。例如，洗衣工有他们自己的种姓，理发师也有他们自己的种姓，全国总共有数千个种姓。

印度的商业企业完全掌握在英国人手中，他们在政治和经济方面也拥有重要影响力。印度有120多个小邦，每个邦都有自己的首领。英国人一直利用这些首领互相制衡，以防止国家统一。印度实际上并非被英国所毁，而是印度人自己因渴望个人权力而将其拱手相让。

1920年，印度革命领袖甘地突然推行消极抵抗政策，该政策已实行十余年。现在英国人正残酷对待印度人。印度所有官方机构的主管均为英国人，借此手段，英国人监视着印度革命者的活动，同时削弱了甘地的权力。甘地已辞去全印国大党主席一职，并特意组织了一场社会运动，旨在废除种姓制度。虽然中国目前的局势非常糟糕，但其人民仍有自由做任何他们想做的事。印度衰败的事实可作为中国加强自身、拯救自身的动力，另一方面，中国也应进行内部改革，以使国家免于衰败。

Sir,
At 3.10 p.m. D.S.I. Grubb brought to the station Chapei Constable No.51 attached to 6 Division, Jessfield Police station, also Woo Kuh Ping, Yue Shuh Ziang and Moo Jeu Yah whom he arrested on Jessfield Road for illegally functioning by collecting census papers Grubb saw them coming out of the compound of No.15 Jessfield Road which is occupied by Chinese and on questioning them as to what they were doing, the policemen said they were taking a census. He was questioned at the station as to whether or not he was aware the taking of the census was not allowed for the present, he declared he did not know there was anything against it. He was already working on the job for a couple of weeks. He was billeted at a Sub-station on the other side of the Soochow Creek, the men who were with him were voluntary hands who had come forth and offered their services when a meeting of the residents in the vicinity of Jessfield village was called, and volunteers asked for a couple of weeks back.

The A/D.C.P. was communicated with and gave instructions to deal with the policeman on similar lines to those brought in the previous day. This was done.

Sir,
At 1.30 p.m. Mr. Snape residing at No.94 Yu Yuen Road came to the station and reported that two Chapel policemen were proceeding along Yu Yuen Road calling at every house taking a census, he refused them admittance to his house. Inspector Foley and C.D.C. 54 Yuan Yao proceeded out at once in the station m/car and proceeded west along Yu Yuen Road and when nearing Edinburgh Road observed a Chapel policeman walking on the footpath on the south side of the road, he was in uniform but did not carry arms. He scrutinised the houses on his left as he passed them by, when within about fifty yards of Edinburgh Road, he retraced his steps and gave his attention to the houses on the north side of the road, when within about 150 yards west of the public school for girls, he crossed the road to the north side and entered a private road. At this point Inspr. Foley and the C.D.C. made their presence known to him, whereupon he started to undo one of his putties and assumed an air of indifference to our presence. He was asked what he was doing about on a Municipal Road and what had become of the other man who had been with him (See Mr. Snape's report), he simply waved his hand in the direction of a Chinese occupied house further up the road, remarking "he has gone in there, we are taking census but of Chinese only." The other man who was loaded up with papers, books, tin can etc, etc, (shown over leaf) (seized) came up and both were conveyed to the station in the station m/car where their names, rank and numbers were secured. The man referred to as scrutinising the houses on Yu Yuen Road is Zau S Ong, Sergeant No.3, but minus stripes. The other man is Lee Ding Faung, both attached to the 6th Division, Zau Ka Doo. The Commissioner of Police was communicated with and gave instructions for all papers, books etc. seized to be detained pending some responsible person

Letter dated September 13 from the
Senior Consul to the Chairman of
the Council.

In the past a census has been taken by the Council every
five years of Chinese and Foreign residents within the Settlement.
The method adopted is for a form to be left at each house with a
request that it be filled up on a certain date. In regard to
Foreigners the particulars required include nationality, sex, age
and occupation. The Chinese are asked to supply details as to the
number of persons, distinguishing between adults, and children
male and female, and their native province. The forms are distributed
by the Council's officials i.e. Tax Collectors or members of the
Police Force seconded for the purpose and are subsequently collected;
the information given being afterwards tabulated in this office.
The number of each house is written on the census form for convenience
of distribution and collection.

It will be a comparatively easy matter to undertake a
special census of foreigners on the outside roads as all the houses
are properly numbered.

To obtain a correct census of Chinese in the outlying
districts will not be so easy. In the first place the house
numeration, owing to the action of the Chinese Authorities, is in a
hopeless muddle. In the ordinary way the Council's officials are
not allowed to function on roads policed by Chapel and similarly
Chapel police cannot function on Council roads.

过去，工部局每五年对在租界内居住的中外居民进行一次户口调查。
采用的方法是在每户留下一份表格，要求其在指定日期填写。关于
外国人，所需信息包括国籍、性别、年龄和职业。要求华人提供
人数详情，区分成年人与儿童、男性与女性，以及其原籍省份。表格由
工部局职员（即税务征收员或为此目的借调的警务处成员）分发，
随后收回；所提供的信息之后在本办公室汇总制表。
为便于分发和收集，每户的门牌号码均写在户口调查表上。

对界外马路的外国人进行特别户口调查将是相对容易的事，因为所有房屋
均有正规编号。

要获取外围地区华人的准确户口数据则不那么容易。首先，由于
中国当局的作为，门牌编号处于一片混乱之中。通常情况下，工部局职员
不允许在由闸北警察管辖的马路上执行公务，同样，闸北警察也不能在
工部局管辖的马路上执行公务。

I would suggest that the census of Chinese be undertaken
by the Settlement Police and that the Chapel Police be instructed
not to interfere but to co-operate. Passing the 'buck'!
Owing to the confusion of house numbers and the
difficulty of differentiating between properties which come under
the two administrations it may be impracticable to follow the
usual procedure and the particulars required might best be obtained
by a house to house visitation extending say over a period of a
week. In any case I consider the special census as far as the

I would further suggest that the Chinese Authorities be
asked to defray any expense incurred by the Council in connection

Attached are copies of the forms used when the last

August 31, 1928.

Census of Residents within the Jurisdiction
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.

General Chang Ting-fan has received instructions
from the Nanking Government to take a census of residents
in his area. General Chung has entrusted the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau with this task, the carrying out of
which will entail the temporary engagement of some 7,000
persons. It is intended to send out census papers to
all residents on September 2 and 3 and collect them on Sept.
15.

Col. Tai, through Mr. T.T.Chen, requests the
co-operation of the Municipal Police in the matter,
especially in regard to the Northern district where at
points it will be necessary for census takers with their
accompanying police escort to use the Municipal road.
As these escorts will be in uniform, it is perhaps
inadvisable to permit them on our roads, but the difficulty
could be overcome by providing a Municipal Police escort
where necessary.

The Nanking Government intends taking a census of the
entire country, starting with Kiangsu and Chekiang Provinces.
The work so far as these two provinces are concerned must,
according to Nanking's order be completed within three
months.

Jno Robertson

档案号 109524
1928年8月31日。

大上海市政府管辖区域内居民人口普查。

张定璠将军已收到南京政府的指令，要在其辖区内进行居民人口普查。张将军已将此任务委托给上海公共安全局，执行此项任务将需要临时雇用约7,000人。计划于9月2日和3日向所有居民发出普查表格，并于9月15日回收。

戴上校通过 T.T.Chen 先生请求工部局警务处在此事上予以合作，特别是在北区，在某些地点，普查人员及其陪同的警察护卫需要使用工部局道路。由于这些护卫将身穿制服，或许不宜允许他们进入我们的道路，但可以通过在必要时提供工部局警务处的护卫来克服这一困难。

南京政府计划对全国进行人口普查，从江苏省和浙江省开始。根据南京的命令，这两个省份的工作必须在三个月内完成。

Jno Robertson
刑事侦缉处处长。
